title: Dichloroethene reduction by Fe(II): role of transient Fe(II) phases
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00274E, Paper
Caroline E. Chelsvig, Malvika Patial, Drew E. Latta, Paul G. Tratnyek, Anke Neumann, Michelle M. Scherer
In this work, we describe the role of freshly precipitated, transient Fe(II) phases that can catalyze abiotic reduction of cis-DCE.
